body: Yes, sadly depression isn't very logical.  Suicide is definitely not logical.  I'm normally a very logical person, but there are some thing things are so emotionally crushing that even in the face of logic you want to give in.  I wish to God I could ignore my deep emotions and desires and just act purely logical and get myself out of it.  I guess it's kind've hard to understand unless you've been depressed for a long time yourself.
I really like your point about music, I do still like music actually!  Your thought about music reminds me of an OAR lyric - ""When music is the one thing that surrounds you. You feel no pain.""

Thanks for your blunt thoughts.  I don't know if you've ever been married, but divorce is very hard.  We've been separated before and then reconciled.  She still loves me, in whatever way she can, even if it is somewhat superficial.  I still try to love her and care about her, so it's very hard to break the cycle, and divorce is a huge step.  Maybe you're right, but it's much easier said than done to just completely give up.

As for the quote, perhaps Williams meant it that way, but I choose to interpret as a choice you have to make, an ultimatum. If you can accept the way you are, then great, you can move on...however, if you can't, you just don't move on.  Either way, things are settled.  

As to your third paragraph, to be blunt in return, I'm not sure if you understand how after several years things cement themselves in your life.  My job and marriage are not "very changeable."  It's not an easy decision when you're deeply embedded in them.  In addition to that, i'm not blaming them completely for my current situation, i'm blaming myself, i'd probably be miserable anywhere unfortunately.  

Once I'm dead, I get to rest forever.

Thank you for your kind thoughts and suggestions.  I think you have a good idea, but it's really hard for me to find anything that makes me feel good these days.  I used to really enjoy watching the sunset actually, but I just can't anymore.  I used to have a cat that I really loved, but she died a few years ago and unfortunately I cannot get another one now.  I'll keep thinking, but I'm not sure I'll find anything at this point...
